failure: UI offered one cell but inherited anatomy requires at least four. Contract initialization rejected it.
correction: Removed the unsupported UI option and require at least four cells. All eight coupled contracts then passed.

failure: Initial integration retained descriptive exclusive counts without requiring optical opsin-block loss.
correction: Dedicated causal qualifier requires regional, whole-cell and applicable opsin-block loss and always checks exclusivity against the entire assigned row. Regression tests preserve off-targets.

failure: Original PCG residual 1.3595969434732396e-5 after 16000 iterations, fixed gate 1e-10.
correction: Algebra corrected with symmetric equilibration and true-residual observation without breaking PCG recurrence. The finer fixture now passes 1e-10, exposing a separate 14.0–39.7% mesh-transfer discrepancy; the original failure report is retained.

failure: Reverse Cuthill–McKee ordering still failed: residual 0.26948198599014733 after 16000 iterations.
correction: RCM remains rejected. Production preserves the original ordering and uses the separately verified equilibrated solver; physical matrix and acceptance tolerances are unchanged.

failure: Original wire/lead intersection and three insufficiently sampled off-target estimates.
correction: Exact original reports retained under labs/axon-stage2/reports/retained-failures. New finite-shell evidence does not erase these failures.

failure: The combined process exited without a fine report. A separate Python run also terminated with exit code 137 before a report was written.
correction: No numerical conclusion. Matrix refinement remains unqualified; process termination does not justify relaxing a tolerance.

failure: After the algebraic correction, per-cell coarse/fine transfer relative L2 errors are 0.1403458256, 0.3973348249, 0.3822908875 and 0.3281912394 against the unchanged 0.05 limit.
correction: Retained as a failed required gate. Magnetic headlines, threshold brackets and operating-point selection are withheld; complete nominal matrices, traces and controls remain diagnostics.

failure: Four-point tetrahedral integration reduces per-cell mesh errors to 0.0056415, 0.0449371, 0.1055674 and 0.0604411; two of four still fail.
correction: Diagnostic only, not promoted to production. Both the original vertex-average rule and this rejected correction are retained.

failure: Independent NumPy assembly with 25000-element chunks and SuperLU symmetric minimum-degree ordering terminated with exit code 137 before writing a fine result.
correction: No numerical conclusion. Neither the mesh criterion nor independent-reference requirement is relaxed.

failure: Eleven-point Keast degree-four source integration gives transfer refinement errors 0.00549765, 0.05282858, 0.10095172 and 0.06121572. Three cells exceed the unchanged 0.05 gate.
correction: Not promoted. Exact polynomial moments through degree four pass analytic simplex-integral checks. Source integration alone does not resolve the mesh discrepancy.

failure: The first conservative 1→2 mesh attempt failed current balance (−1.3177e−14 versus 1e−15) and transfer refinement (11.51%, 5.19%, 10.03%, 6.18% versus 5%).
correction: Original report retained in induction-conservative-initial-failure.json. Higher-order face/volume quadrature and a genuinely finer baseline are being qualified; a different passing fixture cannot certify the old mesh.

failure: Initial ILUT factorization was singular. A different ordering successfully factored but BiCGSTAB returned breakdown −10 with a per-unit-slew RHS norm of 3.035e−12.
correction: Both failed attempts are retained. Normalizing the algebraic RHS and restoring its physical magnitude avoids BiCGSTAB breakdown. The independent physical reference then passes at both mesh sizes; it is refreshed again after the production solver correction. No stimulus, physical field, trace amplitude, timing or acceptance tolerance is fitted.

failure: The initial supplemental assertion incorrectly expected a shared-only output from duplicate exclusive rows. The calculated matrix correctly contained three nonzero rows recruiting two distinct cells.
correction: The original failure is retained in spectral-crosstalk-initial-assertion-failure.json. Reanalysis of the unchanged raw run checks the established metric: E0002 counts once, distinct exclusive outputs = 2 and rank = 2. No model, stimulus or numerical tolerance changed.

failure: The first refinement-4 solve reached the unchanged 16000-iteration cap at true residual 1.756456346689821e−10 versus the 1e−10 gate; it produced no qualified fine transfer.
correction: The full failure and coarse result are retained in induction-conservative-refinement-algebra-failure.json. Compensated residual observation and refinement from the original physical equation replace restart from the rounded equilibrated coefficients. The same physical matrix, load and acceptance limits are retained.

failure: The finest mesh still failed at residual 1.3315927995857793e-10 after 16000 iterations with 4376 restarts.
correction: Retained in induction-conservative-physical-residual-failure.json. Two-component physical state and residual, error-free products and exact axial-column block preconditioning pass the same matrix and unchanged gates.

failure: Relative transfer errors are 0.8357%, 3.8994%, 3.6748% and 5.3361%. The fourth exceeds the unchanged 5% limit.
correction: Factor 2 remains rejected in induction-conservative-2-to-4-failure.json. Production is actually remeshed at factor 3 and compared against factor 4, with a new independent physical reference. The change was declared in induction-resolution-correction.json before execution.

failure: Cell 2 transfer relative L2 is 5.522489595%, exceeding the unchanged 5% criterion.
correction: All original rows retained in induction-conservative-3-to-4-failure.json. A separately predeclared axial refinement separates axial and radial contributions.

failure: The independent child terminated after physical stiffness assembly and before writing a result. No numerical conclusion.
correction: The reference now cancels equal-conductivity internal faces by sorted incidence before allocating face coordinates. Earlier failure remains retained. All original comparison tolerances are unchanged.
